title: Magic Scones
description: Fluffy scones made from self-raising flour, double cream and a can of lemonade. Virtually indistinguishable from traditional scones — defy anyone to spot the difference.

ingredients.text: 600g self-raising flour, plus extra for dusting

steps: Sift the flour into a bowl. Add the cream slowly, then the lemonade. Stir with a metal spoon.
Use your hands to bring the dough together into a ball, adding more flour if too sticky. Turn on to a floured surface and knead lightly.
Pat to about 4cm thick and cut into circles with a 7cm fluted cutter (or the rim of a glass). Place on a baking sheet lined with greaseproof paper, 3cm apart.
Bake for 20 minutes until golden on top. Cool on a wire rack.
notes: Makes 10 large scones. Serve with jam and clotted cream.
